findings.mechanism: SQL query built with string interpolation of untrusted claims.sub and status, allowing injection
findings.remediation: use parameterized query: pool.query('SELECT id, sku, quantity FROM orders WHERE customer = $1 AND status = $2', [claims.sub, status])

findings.mechanism: sequential fetch per order row causes latency scaling linearly with number of rows
findings.remediation: fetch all quotes in parallel with Promise.all or add batch endpoint

findings.mechanism: fetch called without timeout can hang indefinitely, tying up worker threads
findings.remediation: wrap fetch with AbortController and set timeout (e.g., 2s)

findings.mechanism: fs.writeFileSync blocks event loop, limiting throughput under concurrent requests
findings.remediation: replace with await fs.promises.writeFile for non-blocking I/O

findings.mechanism: jwt.decode used without signature verification, allowing forged tokens
findings.remediation: use jwt.verify(token, SECRET) and handle errors
